posts.flux: Sunrise over a calm river ghat, bamboo soop baskets with fruits, sugarcane and thekua on the steps, lit diyas floating on the water, golden sun on the horizon, no people

quoteText.dev:
दुख में सुमिरन सब करे, सुख में करे न कोय।
जो सुख में सुमिरन करे, दुख काहे को होय॥
quoteText.roman: Dukh mein sumiran sab kare, sukh mein kare na koy
quoteText.meaning: Bhagwan ko sirf dukh mein nahi, sukh mein bhi yaad karein.
